races.name: Strawmax Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Dartmouth Castle
runners_data.note: Clear pace advantage with proven front-running ability, 26 days since impressive all-the-way win at Sedgefield over similar trip on good ground
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner on fast ground; off the mark over hurdles last time (made all); solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Sedgefield bumper winner last May (2m1f, good to firm); off the mark over hurdles with a wide-margin success on same track last time (2m4f, good; made all; left clear two out); the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Kashchei
runners_data.note: Hold-up style handicapped by exposed maiden form, though RPR suggests more ability than recent efforts indicate with cheekpieces retained
runners_data.comment: Maiden; two fair runs on soft/heavy in the winter; well beaten latest; bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Irish raider; exposed maiden; two fair runs on soft/heavy this year but well beaten with cheekpieces tried (on again) at Downpatrick last time (2m6f, yielding to soft); bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Rupert The Prince
runners_data.note: Flat winner stepping up in trip but concerning 111-day layoff and poor hurdles debut, visor applied suggests attitude issues
runners_data.comment: Fair stayer on the Flat; cost 36,000gns; poor effort on jumps debut; can do better
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times at up to 2m on the Flat for Paddy Butler; bought for 36,000gns in October; third in a 2m handicap at Ripon 11 days ago having disappointed in a Newcastle maiden hurdle on jumps debut in January (2m1f, good to soft; cheekpieces on instead of visor); visor back on, this longer trip should suit, and improvement likely.

races.paceDynamic: Dartmouth Castle will control this race from the front, with his confirmed front-running style facing no serious pace pressure from the other two runners. Rupert The Prince may track from prominent position early but lacks recent form, while Kashchei's hold-up style means he'll be settling last. The uncontested lead will allow Dartmouth Castle to dictate fractions and kick when ready, creating a tempo that suits his stamina and tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours the front runner who can control the pace without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dartmouth Castle gets an easy lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: His wide-margin Sedgefield success showed he's effective when making all, and with no pace pressure he can time his effort perfectly. The 2m5f trip suits his stamina profile and he carries the highest rating with proven hurdles form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Challenge Success
scenarios.trigger: If Kashchei times his run perfectly from the rear
scenarios.body: The Irish raider's hold-up style could benefit if Dartmouth Castle goes too fast early, though his exposed maiden status is concerning. His RPR of 122 suggests ability but recent form lacks conviction.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Rupert The Prince can track the pace and outstay the leader
scenarios.body: His flat racing background over 2m gives him stamina credentials, but 111 days off and disappointing recent hurdles debut are major negatives. The step up in trip might suit but fitness is questionable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Dartmouth Castle goes too fast early and stops
scenarios.body: This would require the leader to misjudge the pace badly given the lack of pressure, opening the door for either trailer. However, his recent controlled performance suggests he's learned tactical lessons.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Dartmouth Castle gets pressured early - his game plan relies on controlling the tempo without interference
Monitor Kashchei's jumping - Irish raider needs to stay in touch given small field and likely slow pace that won't suit closers
Check Rupert The Prince's market support - any confidence would be significant given his fitness concerns and long absence
Watch for tactical changes if pace becomes crawling - hold-up horses need some tempo to be effective in finish
Observe Dartmouth Castle's jumping rhythm - any mistakes could disrupt his front-running strategy and open race up

races.name: Racing TV Profits Returned To Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Walk On Quest
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should get ideal position tracking Presentandcounting but needs to time his challenge perfectly on good ground where he's shown his best form previously.
runners_data.comment: Won 4 handicaps 2 seasons ago; sound run when beaten a nose over C&D latest; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Won four handicaps on the trot two seasons ago (2m-2m5f, good to soft/soft); hasn't won since but was beaten only by a nose over C&D on good last time; contender.

runners_data.name: The Clonmel Kid
runners_data.note: Prominent style on lightest weight with confidence from Newcastle victory, but faces significant class rise against higher-rated opponents in small field.
runners_data.comment: Off the mark on second chase start last time (2m4f); seems to stay 3m; stiffer task
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on second chase start when scoring at Newcastle last time (2m4f, good); seems to stay 3m, but this looks tougher.

runners_data.name: Presentandcounting
runners_data.note: Natural leader who will control this small field from the front, with excellent course form and proven stamina for the trip on suitable good ground.

races.paceDynamic: Presentandcounting will lead from the start with his natural front-running style, setting what should be an uncontested pace given Walk On Quest and The Clonmel Kid both prefer prominent positions rather than leading. With only three runners, the early gallop will be steady rather than fierce, allowing Presentandcounting to dictate terms without pressure. The race will likely develop into a tactical affair where positioning at the business end matters more than early pace, but the sustained nature of the gallop over this trip means the two prominent runners will need to time their challenges perfectly. This pace scenario clearly favours the leader Presentandcounting, who can control the race without interference and kick when it suits.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Presentandcounting Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Presentandcounting gets an easy lead and isn't pressured until late.
scenarios.body: He can dictate a rhythm that suits his stamina and kick clear when the challengers come, having saved energy by leading uncontested. His front-running style thrives when he's not harassed early and can time his own effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Walk On Quest Times Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Quest sits off the pace and produces his best finish in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: His prominent style allows him to track Presentandcounting's every move and strike when the leader tires, with his class edge showing late. The good ground suits his previous winning form pattern perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Clonmel Kid Causes Upset
scenarios.trigger: If The Clonmel Kid's recent Newcastle win translates to this higher grade and the pace becomes strong.
scenarios.body: His prominent running combined with confidence from his last victory could see him outbattle more fancied rivals in a slowly-run race. The lighter weight helps him stay competitive against higher-rated opponents.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours None
scenarios.trigger: If all three runners go too slowly early and it becomes a sprint finish where class doesn't tell.
scenarios.body: The tactical nature backfires for all connections with no one willing to commit early, leading to a messy finish where any of the three could prevail. Form and ratings become less reliable in such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Presentandcounting gets harassed early by either challenger as his form suggests he needs to control his own pace to be effective.
Watch The Clonmel Kid's jumping under pressure as his inexperience at this level could show if the pace quickens significantly.
Watch the pace through the middle stages as all three have stamina for the trip and may go too slowly, setting up a tactical finish.
Watch Walk On Quest's position turning in as he needs to be close enough to challenge but not so close he hits the front too early.
Watch for any market moves on The Clonmel Kid as his trainer Philip Kirby has been in good form recently with a decent strike rate.

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: High Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid form figures who can track Kilmore Rock but has been disappointing since his maiden win
runners_data.comment: Disappointing in last two runs and needs to get back near his best to make an impact
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle (2m5f, good) for James Ewart last spring; runner-up in C&D handicap next time but he's not gone on from that and has been disappointing in last two runs; drops back in trip/grade but he needs to get back near his best to make an impact.

runners_data.name: Rexem
runners_data.note: Experienced hold-up performer returning to hurdles after pulling up in Ulster National, low trainer strike-rate concern
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in Ulster National (3m4f) latest but he needs a close look back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in the Ulster National (3m4f, soft) in March but he was runner-up in two chase handicaps at Musselburgh (2m4f/2m7f) before that; now returns to hurdling but he's 3-8 in this sphere and is on a dangerous mark on this drop back in trip and grade; one to keep an eye on.

runners_data.name: Kilmore Rock
runners_data.note: Defending champion and course winner who sets the pace, blinkers back on after recent C&D success
runners_data.comment: Won this last year and he was good as ever when scoring over C&D last month; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Won this race last year and he improved his hurdling record to 5-13 when beating Jericoacoara over C&D (second-time blinkers) two weeks ago; up 6lb but he was as good as ever with that comfortable success and is a major player again.

runners_data.name: Rememberthename
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who broke his maiden here last month off 5lb lower mark, still relatively unexposed
runners_data.comment: Justified favouritism over 2m2f here last time and he's respected back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt over hurdles when justifying favouritism in a handicap here (2m2f, good) last month; this is tougher off 5lb higher but he seems versatile trip-wise and he still has potential; respected for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Jericoacoara
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer second to Kilmore Rock last time, yet to win since French success in 2023
runners_data.comment: In-form 7yo who was runner-up over C&D last time; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to add to his French hurdle win (2m1f, very soft) in 2023 but he's been placed in last three runs including when second behind Kilmore Rock over C&D (good) last month; should go well again and any rain would be a bonus.

runners_data.name: Starlyte
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse winless in eleven starts since March 2023 victory at this track, now back on winning mark
runners_data.comment: On last winning mark but she was well held behind Kilmore Rock over C&D last month
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 2m5f here (good to soft) last March but he's 0-11 since and was a well-held fourth behind Kilmore Rock over C&D last month; now back on last winning mark but she's not easy to predict and others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Kilmore Rock is the only confirmed front runner and will lead unchallenged through the early stages, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure. High Dancer may track him prominently, but the majority of the field - Rexem, Rememberthename, Jericoacoara and Starlyte - are all hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear. This creates a slow early pace that will inevitably quicken dramatically from the final hurdle as five horses fan out for their finishing kicks. The tactical scenario strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably develop in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kilmore Rock Dominates Again
scenarios.trigger: If Kilmore Rock gets an easy lead and maintains his jumping rhythm like his recent C&D victory.
scenarios.body: The defending champion controls the tempo and has too much in hand when the hold-up horses make their late charges, replicating his winning formula from last year and two weeks ago. His early advantage proves decisive as the closers struggle to make up the ground in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and Kilmore Rock stops in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The slow gallop sets up perfectly for the strong finishers, with Rememberthename and Jericoacoara producing their trademark late runs to sweep past the tiring leader. The winner emerges from the pack of closers who benefit from the target to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: High Dancer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If High Dancer can sit second throughout and outkick Kilmore Rock from the last hurdle.
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets the perfect trip in behind the leader and has enough class to prevail when they turn for home. High Dancer's superior rating tells as he times his challenge perfectly while avoiding the traffic issues affecting the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Rexem Experience Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Rexem's chasing experience helps him navigate the closing stages better than his rivals.
scenarios.body: The veteran's racecraft proves crucial in a messy finish where his ability to find gaps and switch leads gives him the edge. Despite his hold-up style, Rexem's class and tactical nous allow him to emerge from the pack when others are still searching for racing room.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Kilmore Rock gets any early pressure from High Dancer as he needs to dictate terms uncontested to be effective
Monitor the pace through halfway - if it's genuinely crawling the hold-up horses Rememberthename and Jericoacoara become very dangerous
Check Rexem's jumping early as he's returning to hurdles after chasing and needs to settle properly for his finishing kick
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as five hold-up horses will be looking for gaps simultaneously behind the leaders
Observe High Dancer's position turning for home - if he's still on Kilmore Rock's heels he becomes the main danger

runners_data.name: Lester Mail

runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper here last April (2m, good); mixed form over hurdles, including fair fourth on handicap debut here last time (2m2f, good); further progress likely, particularly now up to 2m4f.

runners_data.name: Fairly Fulling

runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Newcastle in March and although 7lb higher, has an each-way chance

races.paceDynamic: Abbey Scope will make the early running with Livano Bello, William Yeats, and Larkfield Lusive pressing from prominent positions, creating a genuine pace through the early stages. The large field of hold-up horses including Cher Tara, Nitty Gritty, Disco Annie, and Joto will create traffic problems and force riders to commit earlier than ideal on the climb to the finish. With multiple prominent runners setting solid fractions and the hold-up brigade potentially caught behind horses, this pace dynamic strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and have clear racing room when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Abbey Scope and the prominent group maintain honest fractions without going too fast
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get caught in traffic on the climb while prominent trackers have clear runs to challenge the leaders in the straight. This large field creates inevitable crowding that penalises those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pace collapses or traffic clears dramatically in the straight
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up performer like Cher Tara or Nitty Gritty finds racing room and benefits from a strong finish when others have used their stamina. The pace scenario allows them to utilise their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Returning Winner Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Larkfield Lusive's 263-day break proves no hindrance and retains last season's form
scenarios.body: The dual summer winner on good ground uses class and tactical speed from a prominent position to outbattle the opposition. Previous course success at similar distances gives significant confidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses or multiple fallers/mistakes create unusual circumstances
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted outsider like Joto or She Won't Mind capitalises on completely changed race dynamics. Requires significant disruption to the expected race flow to materialise.

watchPoints.text: She Won't Mind returning after 351 days off with previous bleeding issues could struggle badly if not fully recovered
Nitty Gritty has pulled up in recent starts suggesting stamina problems that 2m5f could expose again
Abbey Scope's prominent position could be compromised if jockey Danny McMenamin gets too keen early
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 10 runners and multiple hold-up horses needing racing room simultaneously
Larkfield Lusive's fitness after 263-day break will be evident in final furlong when stamina reserves tested

races.paceDynamic: Thorneylands is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate from the start without pressure early. Four horses (Vanilla Dancer, Maillot Blanc, Lone Star, Royal Maggs) want prominent positions creating congestion 2-3 furlongs out when the pace lifts. The hold-up brigade (Return To Florida, Helsgetaway, Long Time Listener, Venturevango) will have plenty to do from off the sustainable early gallop. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good position early and avoid the traffic scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners clash for position approaching the business end
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace becomes frantic when Vanilla Dancer, Maillot Blanc, Lone Star and Royal Maggs converge. Those already in the clear prominent positions benefit most from the interference behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Thorneylands maintains strong gallop and prominent pack fails to organize
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits the lack of early pressure and kicks clear when the prominent runners get in each other's way. Hold-up horses have too much ground to make up from the sustained tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates a stop-start pace allowing closers through
scenarios.body: The traffic problems among the prominent quartet create gaps and slow the tempo enough for hold-up runners to strike. Return To Florida and Helsgetaway benefit from the clear runs created.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits All
scenarios.trigger: If Thorneylands goes too slow and prominent runners conserve energy
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader sets pedestrian fractions allowing everyone to stay in contention. The race becomes a sprint finish where class and condition matter most.

watchPoints.text: Vanilla Dancer and Maillot Blanc clash for the same prominent pitch turning for home creating interference
Thorneylands drifts right under pressure as he did when pulled up previously
Return To Florida gets shuffled back further if the prominent pack compress the field early
Royal Maggs pulls too hard in the hood first time and weakens approaching the final flight
Long Time Listener makes eyecatching late progress if given patient ride by Charlie Maggs

races.paceDynamic: Tanking Along stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop without pressure from the start. Chapel Green, Flash Du Pistolet, Glory And Honour and Intenzo will settle prominently behind, while hold-up merchants Moodofthemoment and Singapore Trip track from the rear. With only one natural leader, the pace will be controlled rather than fierce, allowing the front group to dictate throughout. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and the leader, as they can control the tempo and kick when ready without being softened up by early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along maintains a steady gallop without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader can measure his effort perfectly and prove hard to pass, while prominent runners like Flash Du Pistolet and Glory And Honour can track him into contention. The sustainable pace negates the hold-up horses' finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet press Tanking Along from halfway and expose his stamina
scenarios.body: Flash Du Pistolet and Glory And Honour can use their superior ratings to grind past a weakening leader in the final furlong. Chapel Green and Intenzo benefit from the stronger pace but may lack the class to win.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horses Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong due to prominent runners crowding the leader
scenarios.body: Singapore Trip and Moodofthemoment can use their hold-up style to devastating effect as the leaders tire. The hat-trick seeking Singapore Trip particularly thrives when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a war of attrition between the main contenders
scenarios.body: Intenzo or Chapel Green could steal through as the fancied runners tire from their efforts. The younger Intenzo especially could find improvement stepping up in trip with a strong pace to aim at.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Tanking Along gets any early pressure from the prominent runners as he may not handle a fierce gallop
Monitor Singapore Trip's jumping early as hold-up horses can get caught in traffic in small fields if not positioned well
Check if Moodofthemoment shows early signs of another pull-up after his recent poor completion rate
Watch for Flash Du Pistolet to make his move turning for home as he's the form horse in this grade
Observe if Chapel Green travels with his old enthusiasm given his disappointing recent efforts

races.paceDynamic: Brandy McQueen and Settle Down Jill will set the early pace in this small field, with both confirmed front-runners likely to contest the lead from the off. This creates an honest gallop that should stretch the field, particularly over 2m7½f where stamina becomes crucial. The pace pressure from two willing leaders will set up the race for the hold-up horses to close late. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can benefit from the pace battle upfront and finish powerfully.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Brandy McQueen and Settle Down Jill engage in a pace battle early
scenarios.body: The front-runners will weaken in the final half-mile, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with their superior stamina reserves. Northern Bound and Whatdeawant are ideally positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders breaks clear and avoids the pace battle
scenarios.body: Either Brandy McQueen or Settle Down Jill could steal a march by going clear early, building an unassailable lead while their rival struggles. The hold-up horses would have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dressedtoimpress can track the leaders without being caught in the pace battle
scenarios.body: The prominent runner can benefit from the ideal position behind the pace setters, avoiding their battle but staying close enough to pounce. This tactical advantage could prove decisive in a small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners fade dramatically leaving a tactical muddle
scenarios.body: The race could develop into a sprint finish where any horse still traveling could win regardless of early position. This chaos scenario opens the door for any runner with stamina left.
